name: WARNING: Dutch Bros Golden Eagle Breve (Half-and-Half Heavy Cream Base)
whyItWorks: A 'Breve' uses 100% Half-and-Half cream instead of milk, packing 40g+ of dense dairy fat per cup alongside vanilla and caramel syrup pumps. Severe lactose and bile-dump diarrhea trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always substitute Breve (half-and-half) with oat milk or almond milk, and ask for sugar-free or syrup-free.
